propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate analysed the round telematics and tipping data for a waste collection company's eleven depots for three years under the team's analysis procedure, and prepared the monthly contract performance report for the contract managers.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the report document the analysis and the reports.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate proposed thirty-four round changes with their expected mileage and time effects, with approvals staying with the operations director and the post-change telematics confirming the effect on twenty-nine, and presented each change to the depot manager concerned with the objections and their resolution recorded.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the proposals, the depot review records and the reference call document the proposals and the depot presentations.

propositions.canonicalProposition: In the depot manager role-play the candidate checked the road closure window on the map, moved the affected stops after the window, restated the revised time saving, and noted the objection and the revision on the proposal sheet.
propositions.rationale: The interviewer note records specific observable behaviour tied to the depot presentation requirement, not an impression.

expectedGap: Hand-over conditions are documented in the proposals for approved changes, not for the five changes whose post-change effect fell outside the tolerance.
expectedBoundaryNote: Record the interview observation as what was observed in one role-play; do not extend it into a general judgement of the candidate beyond that observation.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask how the five changes outside the tolerance were followed up and documented with the depots.
